window.holdout_is_not_virgin_at_family_level: The incumbent L5 was already measured in this block at ann Sharpe 2.35. A new formula that merely correlates with it will inherit that number. The decisive held-out statistic is therefore the ALPHA to the incumbent, not the raw Sharpe -- both are reported.

costs.note: both legs charged the measured CEF half-spread on realised turnover; borrow charged at the REALISED 200 bp short rate on the short half, not the 33 bp ETB floor; short leg screened to Alpaca easy_to_borrow

verdict.summary: The family is not noise -- the incumbent L5 held out again at ann Sharpe 2.73 net of measured spread and a 200bp realised borrow. But the NEW territory searched is almost entirely (a) collinear with L5 or (b) closing-print bid-ask bounce. The pre-registered primary FAILED its alpha test out of sample.

preregistered_primary.why: stands alone (held Sharpe 1.77, +18.66 bp/wk, t 2.66, robust to stress at 1.80) but held-out alpha to the incumbent is ZERO: 1-factor alpha t 0.77, 2-factor 1.05, stressed 0.92. Design alpha t was 2.90 and did not replicate. It is a SUBSET of L5 and is worse than L5 (2.73) out of sample.

sole_survivor.rule: discount-LEVEL decile tilt restricted to MUNI + EQUITY CEFs (taxable-credit funds excluded), 1-week hold, dollar-neutral, ETB-screened short leg, price>$5
weaknesses: stressed held-out edge is in ONE half: 1st 57wk Sharpe 0.54, 2nd 57wk 3.53
37% of the stressed held-out mean comes from the 5 best of 114 weeks
short leg is 7 names (median) -- severe concentration, trivial capacity
it was a SECONDARY; the pre-committed primary failed
stressed alpha t 2.93 vs second-round bar 2.751 = 1.06x, not a clear beat
sole_survivor.status: FORWARD-TEST CANDIDATE WITH A GUARD, not a proven edge

verdict.microstructure_finding: The whole short-horizon discount-reversal branch (13w z, orthogonalised z, 1/4/13/26w discount change, acceleration, price-minus-NAV return spread) reaches design t of 5-7 and goes NEGATIVE out of sample once a one-trading-day implementation lag (CEFConnect publishes NAV after the close) and a p90 spread are charged: held stressed alphas of -3 to -7.7. It is the closing-print bid-ask bounce, not an edge.

killed_outright.Y01_yield_tilt: pure PIT distribution-yield tilt, negative in BOTH windows and both signs
killed_outright.S03_S04_navmom: NAV total-return momentum, negative -- price does NOT under-react to NAV
killed_outright.M05_accel: discount acceleration, -3.6 design stressed / -7.7 held stressed alpha t
